faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the National Book Trust recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the National Book Trust Digital Media Expert posts is 11 August 2026. Candidates are advised to send their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Digital Media Expert posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Journalism, Mass Communication, Digital Media, Advertising, or any related fields to be eligible for these positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Digital Media Expert positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the Digital Media Expert posts is 45 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Digital Media Expert roles?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Digital Media Expert positions will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 70,000.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Digital Media Expert posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Digital Media Expert posts, with one position for Digital Media Expert – I and another for Digital Media Expert – II.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the National Book Trust recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Digital Media Expert posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Digital Media Expert posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The Digital Media Expert positions are offered on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the National Book Trust, which is www.nbtindia.gov.in.
